root_cause_analysis: The editorial engine failed a numeric validation check because the deck generation process injected currency symbols (₹) into the numeric metrics. The validator expected raw integers (250, 844) as found in the source metrics, but encountered formatted strings ('₹250', '₹844'), triggering a type mismatch and pipeline halt.
actionable_instructions: Update the editorial_engine.py regex parser to strip currency symbols (₹) from numeric fields before validation.
Modify the deck composition schema to enforce integer-only types for metric fields to prevent future string-based injection.
Re-run the pipeline after applying the sanitization logic to the metric extraction layer.
